panelCertificate.heading: Panel certificate
panelCertificate.subtitle: The certificate this panel's own interface is served with.
panelCertificate.selfSigned: The panel is served with its self-signed certificate, so browsers warn before opening it.
panelCertificate.issueHint: The panel validates its host name over HTTP on port 80 and installs the result. The host name must point at this server; if issuance fails, the current certificate stays in place. A trusted certificate renews by itself.
panelCertificate.issued: The trusted certificate is installed. Reload the page to use it.
